title: Evaluation kickoff workflow for pinned-model promotions with differential sampling
creator: Alyssa Chen
description:
Goal: Implement a robust kickoff workflow that automatically launches targeted evaluations when a model version is promoted or a customer pins a model. The workflow should: 1) detect version pin/upgrade events from both catalog edits and customer pin actions; 2) select an evaluation profile based on model class, customer SLA tier, and recent traffic characteristics; 3) run differential sampling (small, representative subset + higher-fidelity targeted probes) to balance speed and cost; 4) surface deterministic pass/fail signals and human-review recommendations; 5) integrate with existing rollouts/canary tooling to gate promotions when thresholds fail.

Key design choices: differential sampling reduces cost for low-risk, high-volume customers by combining lightweight synthetic probes with a small random sample of live traffic (privacy-safe). High-risk customers (SLA-tiered or regulated) trigger a fuller preflight run. Thresholds are configurable per-catalog-entry and overridable by account teams.

Success criteria: automated evals start within 3 minutes of a pin event; 90% of catalog pins complete a lightweight verdict within 30 minutes; high-confidence regressions raise alerts to SRE/PM/RE and block automated rollout; metrics captured in Console: eval latency, token cost, regression precision/recall, and false-positive rate of blocks.
updates: 2026-02-19: Scoping meeting with Eng (Marcus), Research (Priya), and Console (Diego). Agreed on three evaluation tiers: smoke (5–10m), sample (30–60m), full (up to 4h).
2026-02-25: Decision: differential sampler will use stratified sampling by prompt length and customer route; privacy review required for live-sample ingestion (contacted security).
2026-03-02: Engineering spike (ENG-2411) validated event hook latency; prototype webhook delivers pin events in ~45s in staging.
2026-03-05: Design review feedback: make alert messaging explicit about customer-visible changes and include rollback links in Console. UX mockups stored in Drive (see links).
2026-03-09: Implemented initial runbook for manual intervention and human-in-the-loop approval; added metric tracking for false-block incidents. Ready for paired QA with SRE next week.

Priya Rao (Research): We'll provide a default eval suite per model family and a configurable delta-sensitivity parameter used to tune regression thresholds.
Diego Alvarez (Console): Will add a per-pin timeline card showing eval progress, verdict, and quick actions (rollback/approve). Requires backend event stream.
